description.value: Chicken World is a halal-certified Canadian fast food chain specializing in fried and peri peri chicken alongside an extensive menu of burgers, wraps, and sides. The Denman Street location sits in Vancouver's West End, a short ride from the Stanley Park seawall — one of BC's most heavily used cycling corridors. Dine-in, takeout, and online ordering are all available.

bike_parking_detail: 6 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 21m; stands (2 spaces) at 76m; stands (5 spaces) at 77m; stands (6 spaces) at 83m; stands (2 spaces) at 87m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m. Total: 19 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM and website both confirm the Downtown location at #1181 Denman St., Vancouver with phone 604-681-0007, and the website is live and consistent. Takeout is supported by OSM tag takeaway=yes and the website's online ordering feature. A Veggie Burger appears on the burgers menu page, confirming at least one vegetarian option. No bike parking, washroom, or water-refill information appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all three required criteria remain null.
concerns: Website About Us page states the business offers dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery, but OSM tag drive_through=no — discrepancy unresolved.
Website contact page lists postal code V3V 6A8 for the Downtown Vancouver location; that code belongs to Surrey, BC — apparent copy-paste error on the website.
Website copyright footer reads '© 2027 Chicken World', which is future-dated relative to today (2026-05-27); minor anomaly, not indicative of closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active food business in a high-traffic cycling area, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Veggie Burger listed on the burgers menu page
